articles.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
articles.summary: For more than 150 years, the Riemann hypothesis has stood as one of the major unsolved problems in mathematics. Anthropic hasn't solved it — but the company's models made more progress than you might expect.

articles.summary: Back after ~6 months — rebuilding my spiking language model around CPU-first inference Hey everyone. I basicall disappeared for a while 😅, but recently I came back to the project, went through the old architecture again, and realized I didn’t really want to keep stacking fixes on top of it. articles.title: JetBrains Details Its First Steps to Bring Rapidly Growing AI Spend Under Control
articles.summary: JetBrains has described how it began centralising AI usage after development-related spending increased roughly tenfold in six months. Rather than restricting engineers to a small set of approved tools, the company built a shared access and accounting layer intended to preserve tool choice while giving teams greater visibility and control over consumption. By Matt Foster
